### CSNN: Neural-Network Compressive Spectrum Sensing
[Graduate research · RF · PyTorch]{.tags}

System-level architecture for a neural-network-based RF compressive spectrum
sensing system, validated under sub-Nyquist sampling in PyTorch, with hardware
performance emulated using approximate analog margin-propagation compute.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.project-card}
### Low-Noise, Wide-Tuning-Range PLL
[ECE 524 · Wireline · Mixed-signal]{.tags}

An 8-phase PLL for a 16 Gb/s wireline transceiver, targeting low noise and
1 GHz of frequency coverage. Bandwidth and architecture chosen to minimize
jitter under high-speed-link noise constraints.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.project-card}
### Elliptic Low-Pass Switched-Capacitor Filter
[ECE 626 · Analog CMOS]{.tags}

A 5th-order elliptic switched-capacitor filter meeting gain, ripple, and area
constraints, with dynamic-range and minimum-capacitance scaling and analysis of
charge injection, op-amp offset, finite gain, and bandwidth limits.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: {.project-card}
### TouchSynth Modular Audio Synthesizer
[Senior capstone · Analog · Power]{.tags}

An audio synthesis platform where users draw waveforms on a touchscreen.
Includes a 4-pole 24 dB/octave voltage-controlled filter with CV-adjustable
cutoff and resonance, and a low-noise triple-rail power supply.
:::
:::
